university_building.name: University Building
university_building.description: A large, labyrinthine building filled with classrooms and offices.

textbook.name: Advanced Textbook on Magic
textbook.description: A book containing intricate magic formulas.

key1.name: University Campus Key
key1.description: A key that grants access to various areas of the university building and its classrooms.

professor.name: Professor Riddle
professor.description: A notoriously difficult professor known for his cryptic lectures and challenging exams.
professor.image_prompt: elderly wizard teacher, old-fashioned clothes, glasses

dialogues.before_talk: Riddle: Welcome, student. You must earn the right to enter my classroom by solving these riddles.
dialogues.after_talk: Riddle: Not yet ready? Go to the bookstore and find a textbook on magic.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Riddle: Excellent work! Here is your key to the university building.
dialogues.hostile: Riddle: Offender! Guards, stop this student!

alyssa.name: Alyssa
alyssa.description: The eager and determined student seeking knowledge from Professor Riddle.
alyssa.image_prompt: student looking at books, determination in her eyes

dialogues.before_talk: Alyssa: Thank you for the key, professor. I will continue my studies now.
dialogues.after_talk: Alyssa: I have a textbook to find and riddles to solve!
dialogues.after_satisfied: Alyssa: Thank you! With the key I can enter your classroom now!
dialogues.hostile: Riddle: Not yet, Alyssa. You must do better!
